channel.title: 我嘅每日話題
channel.description: 每日精選時事、商業、股市、宇宙、科技話題

item.title: Arabica Coffee Prices Hit Record on U.S., Colombia Tariff Spat
item.description: Arabica coffee prices hit a record level, as traders digested the withdrawal of President Trump’s threats to impose tariffs and economic sanctions on Colombia.

item.title: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
item.description: Gain insight on Experian, SoFi Technologies and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

item.title: DeepSeek Won't Sink U.S. AI Titans
item.description: Panic fueling the selloff of Nvidia, Broadcom and other tech giants is overblown.

item.title: Comex Gold, Silver Settle Lower
item.description: Gold settled 1.4% lower, down two of the past three sessions, and silver fell 2.5%, down three of the past four sessions.

item.title: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
item.description: U.S. stocks were mostly lower, with the Nasdaq leading declines as makers of AI infrastructure suffered steep falls, many in the double digits. Nvidia was down 16%.

item.description: Xbox's former chief operating officer, Helen Chiang, suddenly left Microsoft less than two weeks ago after being promoted into the role in July. item.description: Anthropic has updated Claude Code's system prompt to prevent the AI tool from being used to re-create existing video games, as reported by Tom's Hardware. item.description: Ford vowed to never sell customer driving data to third-party data brokers as part of a new privacy promise aimed at setting the automaker apart from competitors that have faced legal and regulatory blowback for sharing telematics with data brokers without authorization. item.description: The Apple Watch Ultra 4 is the company’s most capable smartwatch. item.description: BMW says that it will expand its navigation-guided, partially automated driving capabilities into urban environments starting in 2027, launching first in Germany with other markets to follow. item.description: Google says one of its Android manufacturing partners secretly built a backdoor in 1.3 million devices and turned them into a botnet. item.description: Meta is planning to release the last OS update for its Quest 2 and Quest Pro VR headsets by March 2027, the company announced today. item.description: Apple had a record-breaking quarter for iPhone sales - despite not releasing a standard model during its latest refresh. item.description: Apple CEO John Ternus doesn't have a timeline for when iPhone Duo supply constraints could lift. During an interview with Reuters, Ternus said the company is "working hard to get it to as many customers as quickly as possible, but at this ​point, we're not able to predict when supply and deman

item.title: Readwise takes on Amazon’s Kindle and Goodreads with its new app for book lovers
item.description: Readwise Books combines an e-book store, reading tracker, detailed reading stats, and AI features in a bid to challenge Amazon's ecosystem.

item.title: In one of the largest deals in tech history, Marvell buys Lumentum for $115B
item.description: Marvell's planned purchase of Lumentum is one of the biggest acquisitions in tech history. And they both have the same strategic investor: Nvidia.

item.title: Snap settles lawsuit accusing platform of fueling teen depression and eating disorders
item.description: The plaintiffs said they started using YouTube as young as age 3 and other social media platforms at around age 9 and developed compulsive usage habits that they attributed to features such as autoplay and infinite scrolling.

item.title: New York Times and other outlets sue web browser Brave over alleged content scraping
item.description: The New York Times is suing privacy-focused web browser company Brave for allegedly scraping the outlet’s copyrighted content and unlawfully distributing it to its own customers, like Anthropic and Perplexity.

item.title: Web host Squarespace lays off 19% of its employees
item.description: The website builder said that the job losses are part of a broader restructuring of its organization.

item.title: Germany says lawmakers’ iPhones may have been hacked with spyware
item.description: German lawmakers and a filmmaker are among the people who received notifications from Apple warning that their phones may have been hacked.

item.title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
item.description: RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return.

item.title: Apple’s inventory surges 154% as memory chip costs climb
item.description: Apple says unprecedented memory chip costs will continue to rise, raising questions about future device prices as its inventory climbs to $14.5 billion.

item.title: Trajectory raises $45M to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts
item.description: The one-year-old startup is now valued at $300 million.

item.title: Apple says it’s ‘hard to predict’ when iPhone Duo constraints will improve
item.description: Apple says iPhone Duo production is ramping up, but it still can't say when supply will catch up with demand as shipping delays stretch into next year.

item.title: Hinge tests a cheaper plan as users become more fed up paying for dating apps
item.description: At a time when people are increasingly tired of dating apps, Hinge is testing a cheaper subscription plan.

item.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan uses AI agents so much, he spends up to $200K a year on tokens
item.description: Y Combinator Garry Tan has jokingly admitted that he's suffered from "cyber psychosis” and barely sleeps sometimes because he’s so excited to be working with his AI agents. On a new episode of Walter Isaacson’s podcast, The Builders, Tan put a price tag on his passion.

item.title: Ukraine’s new pocket-sized gadget turns Russian drones’ cameras against them
item.description: A Kyiv startup’s pocket-sized, 10-ounce receiver lets Ukrainian troops watch the video feeds of Russian drones, though Russian moves toward digital video and AI-guided drones that emit no signals could make the victory short-lived.

item.title: Apple may try to increase revenue by doing…something with third-party AI apps
item.description: Apple hinted at ways that it could spur revenue through third-party "opportunities" during its Monday night earnings call.

item.title: Google takes Dreambeans to India in bid to bring AI-generated personal stories to the masses
item.description: Google's Dreambeans, its latest AI experiment, now supports 13 Indian languages.
